source: tor's own hs_cache_store_as_dir and hs_cache_lookup_as_dir, tor 0.4.7.13
note: An HSDir keys a descriptor by the blinded key inside its signing-key certificate, not by anything the uploader says — the publish URL carries no key at all. So `query` is the name tor chose, and our fetch path has to produce the same one or a service publishes into a slot nobody looks in.

controls.name: one byte of the encrypted body flipped
the right descriptor, looked up under an all-zero key
